items.name: sahajiv
items.title: SahaJiv
items.description: SahaJiv tokens, fonts, reset, and Tailwind v4 theme bridge.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Organizes related sections into expandable panels so readers can open the details they need.

items.name: adjuster
items.title: Motion Adjuster
items.description: Provides live controls for the shared motion settings and editable body profiles used across the library.

items.name: agent-chat
items.title: Agent chat
items.description: A composable agent conversation with a bounded thread, draft composer, attachments, progress, explicit permissions and choice prompts.

items.name: agent-state
items.title: Agent state
items.description: A sculpted, living status field that changes contour and color as an agent thinks, works, asks for input, or finishes.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Displays a prominent message with context and optional actions where an issue or outcome occurs.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Pauses a workflow for a focused confirmation before a consequential action proceeds.

items.name: ambient-background
items.title: Ambient background
items.description: Adds a quiet animated composition around content, with decorative shapes kept behind a readable surface.

items.name: animated-icon
items.title: Animated icon
items.description: Contextual motion for the shared icon catalog: draw, tremor, spinning settings, bouncing navigation and morphing validation.

props.name: open
props.description: Omit to follow the closest native trigger's data-state/aria-expanded.

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated number
items.description: A smooth, interruptible number transition for totals, metrics and small moments of progress.

props.name: duration
props.description: Transition time in milliseconds, bounded to 0–2000.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Text for NaN or infinite values; never presents missing data as zero.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Layered area charts with shared series colors, responsive bounds and a keyboard data inspector.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Keeps a media container at a chosen width-to-height ratio as its available width changes.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: Presents a file name, type, metadata, and nearby actions as a compact attachment row.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Identifies a person or entity with an image, fallback content, or a grouped set of avatars.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Adds a compact status, count, or category label alongside other content.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Compare series with grouped, stacked or horizontal bars and a shared interactive tooltip.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Shows the current location within a hierarchy and links back to its ancestors.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: Groups conversational content and timestamps into visually distinct message bubbles.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action with native button behavior and an optional busy indicator.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Places related actions together and can track one selected button value.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Displays a month grid for choosing a single date, with optional disabled dates and visual marks.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Groups related content, metadata, and actions into a distinct surface.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Lets readers move through a horizontal collection of slides using scrolling and navigation controls.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Presents numeric comparisons as bars, lines, rings, or ranked rows with companion data-table primitives.

items.name: chart-tooltip
items.title: Dynamic chart tooltip
items.description: A shared bounded data pill with kinetic tracking and pointer/keyboard access.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Captures an independent checked, unchecked, or indeterminate choice.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Displays a code snippet with an optional caption, language label, wrapping, and copy feedback.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Shows or hides one optional section without leaving the surrounding layout.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Filters a list of options through text input and stores one selected value.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Builds a searchable command list that users can navigate and activate from the keyboard.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Reveals contextual actions for a target through a context-menu interaction.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Displays records with client-side filtering, sortable columns, and paginated rows.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: The index is the row's position in data, before filtering or sorting.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Opens a calendar from a compact trigger to choose and display one date.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Opens a focused overlay for a task or information that needs dedicated attention.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets a text direction for a subtree and shares it with direction-aware primitives.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Presents dialog content in a drawer surface while keeping the current page underneath.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Opens a compact menu of actions or stateful choices from a visible trigger.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: Collects local files through drag and drop or a native file picker and reports the selection.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum bytes per file. Omit to leave file size unrestricted.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Explains an empty collection or unavailable result and creates space for a useful next step.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Connects a form control with its label, description, and validation message.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Shows supplementary preview content when a user hovers over or focuses its trigger.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon and icon button
items.description: Renders named SVG icons and provides supporting icon-button and decorative disk primitives.

props.name: feedback
props.description: One-shot feedback from the nearest control. Disable when another owner animates this icon.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Collects a single-line value through a native input with optional composed affixes and clearing controls.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Combines a text control with adjacent prefixes, suffixes, or actions in one input surface.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: Presents a single code input as a sequence of visible character slots.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Presents a compact content row with a title, supporting description, and optional trailing metadata.

items.name: item-adornment
items.title: Item adornment
items.description: Coloured organic shapes for list items, with deterministic automatic selection and custom icon or no-icon options.

props.name: adornmentId
props.description: Keeps the visual identity stable when a label changes or is translated.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Formats a key or key combination as a recognizable keyboard instruction.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Provides a native form label plus compact stat-label primitives for named values.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: Track changes using linear, smooth or step lines with accessible point inspection.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Separates or annotates a sequence with a short event, status, or time label.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Moves a repeating content list with an explicit pause control and a static reading layout when motion is reduced.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Groups application commands into a horizontal row of keyboard-navigable menus.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Structures a conversational or activity entry with a main content area and supporting description.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Keeps a conversation near its latest content while allowing readers to scroll back without being pulled down.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi-select
items.description: Searchable multiple choices with removable selections, form values and clear validation.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible accessible label for the trigger and its choices.

props.name: adornment
props.description: Per-option adornments take precedence over this shared default.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected values. Values absent from options remain removable.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection when value is omitted.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits one hidden form entry per selected value.

props.name: error
props.description: Sets the trigger's invalid state and announces the error.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: Uses the browser’s native select control to choose from a compact list of options.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Organizes destination links and optional expandable navigation panels.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Lets users move between numbered pages and see their current position.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie chart
items.description: Show proportions using themed pie and donut layouts, with readable totals and segment inspection.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Places a dismissible panel next to a trigger for a small contextual task or set of controls.

items.name: presence
items.title: Presence
items.description: MotionPresence keeps keyed children mounted for their exits. MotionSurface adds coordinated lifecycle states to an existing primitive.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge onto exactly one ref-capable child, preserving its native element.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds; use motionTokens.stagger for a coordinated sibling sequence.

items.name: preview
items.title: Component preview
items.description: Pairs a live component example with a code view and a copy action.

props.name: controls
props.description: Variant selectors or other controls shown with the live specimen.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional actions beside the view switcher.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Displays a measured amount of completion or an explicitly unavailable value.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Composes labeled questions, single-choice answers, and visible completion progress.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: Compare several dimensions with a shared radar scale and contextual series highlighting.

items.name: radial-chart
items.title: Radial chart
items.description: Show progress against a shared maximum using full rings or semicircles.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Lets users select one option from a labeled set of mutually exclusive choices.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Divides a region into panels whose relative sizes can be adjusted with a separator.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Contains overflowing content in a bounded viewport with styled scrollbars.

props.name: viewportProps
props.description: Native viewport attributes, including a ref, scroll listener or accessible name.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Opens a list of options from a trigger and stores one selected value.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Divides adjacent content with a horizontal or vertical rule.

items.name: shape
items.title: Shape
items.description: A shared catalogue of 36 SVG silhouettes, with 12 original contours that morph smoothly between shapes.

props.name: label
props.description: Omit for a decorative shape; supply when the graphic carries meaning.

items.name: shape-scene
items.title: Shape scene
items.description: A tactile 3D composition made from SahaJiv shapes, with a static fallback and motion preferences built in.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Opens a side surface for focused secondary content while the current page remains in place.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Provides a collapsible navigation rail with grouped destinations, active states, and a footer area.

props.name: layout
props.description: Container layout fills its parent; viewport layout follows the authored standalone rail.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Reserves the visual shape of content while its real data is still loading.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Adjusts one or more numeric values by moving labeled thumbs along a track.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Loading
items.description: Shows that work is in progress when an exact completion amount is unavailable.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Tracks the current stage of a multi-step sequence and provides previous and next controls.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a named binary setting on or off.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Presents structured data in native rows and columns with headers and an optional caption.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between related content panels while keeping the available views visible.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text reveal
items.description: A quiet word-by-word entrance for headings and short editorial text, with rise and fade treatments.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change this value to deliberately replay the reveal.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Collects multiline text and offers composer and character-count parts for longer input.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: A controlled light/dark switch with a morphing sun and moon. The shared applyTheme helper crossfades inherited surface and text colors.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Reports a brief outcome in a notification area without moving the user away from the current task.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Represents an action or option that stays pressed until it is toggled again.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Groups pressable choices that can allow one or several selected values.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Adds a short supplementary explanation to a trigger on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Provides text roles for headings, body copy, metadata, values, and identifiers.
